final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT b.link_to_event AS ev, e.type AS type, AVG(b.spent * 1.0 / NULLIF(b.amount, 0)) AS r FROM budget b JOIN event e ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event GROUP BY b.link_to_event, e.type), s2 AS (SELECT type, AVG(r) AS r2 FROM s1 GROUP BY type), s3 AS (SELECT AVG(r2) AS r3 FROM s2) SELECT s2.type, s2.r2, s2.r2 * 1.0 / NULLIF(s3.r3, 0) FROM s2 JOIN s3 ON s3.r3 IS NOT NULL
